source_of_truth: hash-matched a1_v24_o3b.py plus dependency sources; contract describes source, not recovered weights or measured behavior
execution_order: Frozen extractor/cache supplies fact_H (2048D) and fact_query_H/query hidden input (2048D).
O21B KeyEncoder maps fact_H to normalized K in R^64; O21A-MR QueryEncoder maps query hidden to normalized Q in R^64.
Initialize K memory zeros [B,4,64], V memory via OracleLocalCore.zero_state zeros [B,4,64], and occupancy zeros [B,4].
For initial facts, frozen O3a K-aware Allocator receives [K_new(64), occupancy(4)] and emits 4 slot logits; occupied slots are masked for safety.
For an incoming fact, frozen key encoder forms K_new. UpdateRouter emits action logits [NEW, UPDATE] and four pair logits. UPDATE if softmax(action)[UPDATE] >= the threshold saved in router_best.pt.

UPDATE selects argmax pair logit over occupied slots, retains the existing K, and writes the new value representation into that V slot. NEW uses the frozen O3a allocator, writes K and V, and marks occupancy.
Read uses normalized Q-to-K dot product divided by temperature 0.1, argmax slot selection, then the selected 64D V state is decoded by the corresponding frozen 64->64 local value head.

components.name: Ouro frozen feature extractor
components.role: produces 2048D hidden vectors used by the caches; O3b integration consumes cache vectors rather than loading Ouro in load_all
components.state_dict_keys: Pinned ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B model.safetensors; not part of O3b router state
components.status: EXACTLY RECOVERABLE as pinned upstream model artifact; M4 did not rehash the 2.87GB file

components.name: R2 OracleLocalCore / VGen2 value path
components.role: content read plus recurrent per-slot V update; VGen2 supplies final trained core state and value heads
components.initializer_status: NOT FOUND; final O3b core state would be supplied by VGen2 if that full checkpoint existed; original source loader nevertheless calls load_r2_checkpoint first
components.status: VGen2 learned core is missing; R2 initializer is an additional upstream training/loader dependency

components.name: O3a K-aware FreeAllocator
components.role: choose a legal free slot for NEW writes

components.name: O3b baseline UpdateRouter
components.role: NEW/UPDATE decision and UPDATE target slot
components.pair_branch: [K_new, K_slot, K_new*K_slot, abs(K_new-K_slot), occupancy_bit] = 257D -> 128 -> 1, per slot

components.name: Retrieval matcher
components.role: select slot from Q and K
components.state_dependency: requires recovered O21B KeyEncoder and O21A-MR QueryEncoder

components.name: Memory initializer and occupancy
components.buffers: none; the V initializer is deterministic zero state, distinct from the learned write-cell weights

components.name: Value decoder
components.role: turn selected V into a 64-class output
components.formula: selected MRValueHeads Linear(64,64) for physical slot

router_action_semantics.update_target: argmax pair logit after masking empty slots
router_action_semantics.new_target: argmax O3a allocator logits after masking occupied slots
router_action_semantics.update_key_rule: retain old K; overwrite/update only selected V slot
router_action_semantics.new_key_rule: write incoming K and V to selected free slot

data_and_mapping.labels: cache metadata; 4 relation names and 64 value classes
